operations.description: Deletes a transcription job. All data related to the job, such as input media and transcript, will be permanently deleted. A job can only be deleted once it's completed (either with success or failure).
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] delete job by id [PATH] jobs [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] deletion found invalid job not state

operations.description: Gets a list of transcription jobs submitted within the last 30 days in reverse chronological order up to the provided `limit` number of jobs per call. **Note:** Jobs older than 30 days will not be listed. Pagination is supported via passing the last job `id` from a previous call into `starting_after`.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list of jobs [PATH] jobs [PARAMS] after limit starting [SCHEMA] descriptionless job options

operations.description: Returns information about a transcription job
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] job by id [PATH] jobs [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA] descriptionless found job not options

operations.description:
Returns the caption output for a transcription job. We currently support SubRip (SRT) and Web Video Text Tracks (VTT) output.
Caption output format can be specified in the `Accept` header. Returns SRT by default.
***
Note: For streaming jobs, transient failure of our storage during a live session may prevent the final hypothesis elements from saving properly, resulting in an incomplete caption file. This is rare, but not impossible.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] captions [PATH] jobs captions [PARAMS] accept channel id speaker [SCHEMA] caption captions format found invalid job not property srt state vtt

operations.description:
Returns the transcript for a completed transcription job. Transcript can be returned as either JSON or plaintext format. Transcript output format can be specified in the `Accept` header. Returns JSON by default.
***
Note: For streaming jobs, transient failure of our storage during a live session may prevent the final hypothesis elements from saving properly, resulting in an incomplete transcript. This is rare, but not impossible. To guarantee 100% completeness, we recommend capturing all final hypothesis when you receive them on the client.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] transcript by id [PATH] jobs transcript [PARAMS] accept id [SCHEMA] format found invalid job not state text transcript

operations.description: Starts an asynchronous job to transcribe speech-to-text for a media file. Media files can be specified in two ways, either by including a public url to the media in the transcription job `options` or by uploading a local file as part of a multipart/form request.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] submit transcription job [PATH] jobs [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] descriptionless job large media options payload submit too url
